{{Top}} {{Character |type=Criminal |image=[[File:Skreek-CGSWG.png]] |name=Skreek |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Trandoshan]]{{Resistance|The Triple Dark}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]] |pronouns=new |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes=[[Color|Yellow]] |skin=Green |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Warbird gang]] *[[First Order]] |masters= |apprentices= }} '''Skreek''' was a [[Trandoshan]] [[Gender|male]] who was a member of [[Kragan Gorr]]'s [[Warbird gang]] during the [[New Republic Era|era]] of the [[New Republic]]. He flew with Gorr and several other [[pirate]]s during an unsuccessful [[Attack on the Colossus|attack]] on the ''[[Colossus]]'' refueling station. Skreek was later there for another [[Raid on the Colossus|raid]] on the platform, where he engaged [[Kazuda Xiono]] in melee combat. When [[Torra Doza]] was kidnapped by the pirates [[Drell]] and [[Valik]], Skreek escorted them and to hand her over to the First Order, but was shot when they betrayed the pirates. ==Biography== {{Quote|The eastern side is open. Go for the fuel storage.''"
"''You heard Kragan. Attack!|Kragan Gorr and Skreek|}} Skreek{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwarsauthentics.com/iSynApp/productDisplay.action?sid=1102083&productId=1365818|text=Skreek|quote=Dee Bradley Baker as Skreek in Star Wars Resistance.|archivedate=20181016063524}} came to join the [[Warbird gang]], a [[pirate]] gang led by [[Kragan Gorr]]. The gang secretly worked for the [[First Order]] in a campaign to force the refueling station ''[[Colossus]]'' to be given over to the latter organization. ===Under the storm's cover=== [[File:KraganGorr-SynarasScore.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Skreek (background) follows Kragan Gorr]] In [[34 ABY]], Gorr sent the [[Neimoidian]] [[spy]] [[Hallion Nark]] to infiltrate the ''Colossus''. After he gave the pirates the go-ahead for a "[[triple dark]]," Gorr devised an [[Attack on the Colossus|attack]] on the refueling station ''Colossus'', with Skreek taking part. Under the cover of a storm, they sprung on the platform and engaged the defending [[squadron]], [[Ace Squadron]]. During the attack, a disturbance in the comm channel caused Skreek and the other pirates to be put off. As they stalled, one [[Unidentified Warbird pirate|pirate]] was shot down, and Gorr ordered the rest of them to retreat. ===Daylight raid=== Sometime later, [[Synara San]], one of the other pirates, managed to infiltrate the ''Colossus'' and contacted Gorr when Ace Squadron was vacant. Led by Gorr, Skreek and the other pirates [[Raid on the Colossus|attacked]] the platform a second time. Skreek flew in aboard a [[speeder bike]] alongside Gorr as he spotted the engineers [[Kazuda Xiono]] and [[Jarek Yeager]] attempting to install a [[targeting computer]] to activate the ''Colossus''{{'}} [[turbolaser]]s. Gorr disembarked with Skreek and a [[Hassk]] pirate to stop them. While Yeager sent the Hassk falling to his doom, Gorr latched onto his [[hoverlift]], and Skreek engaged Xiono. Yeager then rammed his hoverlift into Skreek, knocking him unconscious. When he woke up again, Yeager was still fighting Gorr on the hoverlift, and Xiono was climbing back up to the ledge after briefly falling off. Skreek confronted him, but he grabbed a [[spear]] and [[stun]]ned him. Shortly after, Yeager was able to activate the targeting computer, and Gorr ordered a full retreat, saying that they had done enough damage to the platform.{{Resistance|Synara's Score}} ===Kidnapping Torra Doza=== [[File:BetrayingPirates-TheDozaDilemma.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Major Vonreg and his troops betray Skreek and the other pirates]] Skeek was present when the First Order [[Commander]] [[Pyre]] hired Kragan to [[Torra Doza's abduction|kidnap]] [[Torra Doza]], the daughter of the ''Colossus''{{'}} [[captain]] [[Imanuel Doza]] in order to pressure the later into accepting First Order occupation. Gorr eventually sent the pirates [[Drell]] and [[Valik]] to kidnap Torra with the help of the unwilling [[Synara San]].{{Resistance|The Doza Dilemma}} When Drell and Valik returned to the Warbird gang's headquarters, the ''[[Galleon]]'', with Torra as their captive, Skreek escorted them to meet with [[Major]] [[Elrik Vonreg]] of the First Order, who had requested her capture. As Vonreg arrived, he then double-crossed them and shot Drell. Skreek fired back, but was shot in the chest and fell overboard into the ocean. ===Kaz's appeal=== Later onboard the ''Galleon'', heard from Valik intercepted an encoded transmission sent from the ''Colossus'', which she brought to Kragan. When she decoded the message, it turned out to be a transmission sent to the [[Resistance]] by Kazuda Xiono, calling for help.{{Resistance|Descent (episode)}} ===Battle of Castilon=== Since they received the message, they [[Battle of Castilon|fight]] the First Order until the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Thunderer]]'' has arrived, as Kazuda ordered everyone to head back to the ''Colossus'' as to make a jump into [[hyperspace]] and it did as the pirates including Skreek cheers.{{Resistance|No Escape: Part 2}} ===Salvage the dreadnought=== Kragan, Drell and Valik are laughing that Kazuda Xiono want to help them to [[Skirmish over D'Qar|salvage]] the [[Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought|''Mandator IV''-class Siege Dreadnought]] ''[[Fulminatrix]]'' to get the [[coaxium]], as he tells Kaz they lackeys only take orders from one tyrant, Captain Kragan. As what Kaz said that ''Colossus'' can't jump into hyperspace, they agreed.{{Resistance|A Quick Salvage Run}} ===Having a party=== At [[Aunt Z's Tavern]], it is unknown that the [[gravity generator]] has shut down by [[MB-13A]], as Gork have been punch Skreek is laughing. When the gravity is back, Skreek has landed on the floor at the top of his back of his armor.{{Resistance|Into the Unknown}} ===Salvage the dreadnought=== Skreek was holding a drink, and has been hit by [[Vusk]] as Gork won the wrestling. So Skreek fight him, until, the start of the [[Skirmish over D'Qar|salvaging]] the [[Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought|''Mandator IV''-class Siege Dreadnought]] ''[[Fulminatrix]]''. As Skreek holds a couple of crates, he wonders about the [[coaxium]], he tells Kaz that it's located at the hyperdrive chamber. As he carries more crates, Kragan tells everyone to head back to the ''Galleon''.{{Resistance|A Quick Salvage Run}} ===Hunt the jakoosk=== Skreek was surprised about the people of ''Colossus'', as Drell thinks that Doza's "got a real mess on his hands", Kragan said, "Which means an opportunity for us". Skreek with Kragan to [[Aunt Z's Tavern]] as Kragan tells [[Z'Vk'Thkrkza|Aunt Z]] that he and his crew will go on a [[Mission to Celsor 3|hunt]] for [[jakoosk]]. At the [[Water|ice]] [[moon]] [[Celsor 3]], he and Snarl are on of [[skiff]]s. So Skreek use the [[thermal detonator]]s to get the jakoosk out of its hiding, until the it came in attempt to take it down but it failed. After the jakoosk have been defeated by Kaz with the big laser cannon, Skreek and the others watching cooking the jakoosk meat.{{Resistance|Hunt on Celsor 3}} ==Personality and traits== Skreek was a male Trandoshan with [[Color|yellow]] [[eye]]s and green skin. ==Equipment== Skreek wore [[stormtrooper armor]] over his torso area. He also had [[Color|brown]] trousers and partial bandaging over his shins and lower arms with a forearm armor plating on his right arm. ==Appearances== *{{Resistance|The Triple Dark}} {{1st}} *{{ResistanceAnimationCite|3|The Triple Dark (comic story)}} {{C|Starfighter only}} *{{Resistance|Synara's Score}} *{{Resistance|The Doza Dilemma}} *{{Resistance|Descent (episode)}} *{{Resistance|No Escape: Part 2}} *{{Resistance|Into the Unknown}} *{{Resistance|A Quick Salvage Run}} *{{Resistance|Hunt on Celsor 3}} *{{Resistance|The Engineer}} *{{Resistance|The Mutiny}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/star-wars-resistance/the-triple-dark-episode-guide|text=The Triple Dark Episode Guide}} *{{Destiny|set=Covert Missions|cardname=Pirate Ship|link=https://swdestinydb.com/card/12049}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Skreek |ja=スクリーク |ka=სკრიკი }} [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Trandoshans]] [[Category:Warbird gang members]]
